report_ceo_supply_chain_weekly_supplier_.title: Supplier Risk & Quality Scorecard
report_ceo_supply_chain_weekly_supplier_.description: Weekly CEO-level view of supplier reliability, quality acceptance, defect exposure, and lead time volatility to identify at-risk supply relationships before they impact operations.

report_owner_retail_sales_performance_mo.title: Retail Sales Performance Report
report_owner_retail_sales_performance_mo.description: Monthly sales overview — total revenue, orders, gross margin, top products, top cities, and channel breakdown.

report_cfo_supply_chain_monthly_procurem.title: procurement spend audit & payables health report
report_cfo_supply_chain_monthly_procurem.description: Monthly CFO-level deep dive into procurement spend obligations, tax and discount capture, payables aging (overdue vs paid vs pending), unit cost trends, and purchase order liability exposure — enabling tighter cash flow control and vendor payment governance.

report_coo_supply_chain_adhoc_receiving_.title: Inbound Receiving & Goods Quality Audit Report
report_coo_supply_chain_adhoc_receiving_.description: Ad-hoc deep-dive into inbound goods receipt performance, acceptance vs. rejection rates, damaged line items, and inventory impact — enabling the COO to pinpoint quality failures at the receiving dock and take corrective action with suppliers.

report_ops_supply_chain_daily_warehouse_.title: warehouse capacity & inventory utilization report
report_ops_supply_chain_daily_warehouse_.description: Daily operational view of warehouse capacity consumption, inventory availability, reorder triggers, and stock reservation pressure across all warehouse locations.
